verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes an API reference (e.g. the reference/createtokenv3 page) and provides a first-party Postman collection plus a downloadable OpenAPI schema, which gives users runnable example requests. There is no evidence that the reference itself is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' console. The probe 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict the documented download option. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-docs API explorer with runnable requests, examples of request/response code samples in the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
